note: SEED opens on the refrain bell

text:
This is peaceful, this is excellent, namely the stilling of all
preparations, the relinquishment of all assets, the destruction of
craving, detachment, cessation, extinction.
plain: Nirvana is when everything the mind makes comes to a stop, the letting go of everything carried, the wanting ends, nothing pulls you any more, stopping, going out, like a flame with no fuel.

say: Why don't I see Nibbana right now?

text: Due to the very ignorance of the fact that it is seeing because it is looking, the dog imagines another dog, there, in the water.
plain: You don't see Nirvana right now because you are seeing what you see because you are looking, and you don't know it. Like a dog halfway across a stream on a plank, wagging its tail at its own image in the water: it imagines another dog there, a 'water-dog'. It thinks it is looking because there is something out there to be seen. The moment it realizes it is seeing because it is looking, it stops looking.

text:
Impelled by that imagining, it runs towards the mirage... The gap is
ignored... What impels one to ignore that gap is craving.
plain: Craving keeps it going: impelled by that making it into something, it runs towards the mirage. The gap is ignored. What impels one to ignore that gap is craving.

say: How is the sense of self constructed?

text:
It is when one looks into a mirror that one suddenly becomes self-
conscious... Even if one already has no such notion, the moment one looks
into a mirror one is suddenly reminded of it, as if to exclaim: 'Ah,
here I am!'
plain: The sense of self is constructed like this: when one looks into a mirror one suddenly becomes self-conscious. Even with no such notion, the moment one looks one is reminded of it, as if to exclaim: 'Ah, here I am!'

text: In the seen there will be just the seen... Then you will not be by it. And when you are not by it, you are not in it. And when you are not in it, you are neither here nor there nor in between. This itself is the end of suffering.
plain: Nirvana is attained thus: in the seen there will be just the seen. Then you will not be by it, and when you are not by it, you are not in it, and when you are not in it, you are neither here nor there nor in between. This itself is the end of suffering.

text: I am grown cool, extinguished as I am.
plain: Nirvana is like this: I am grown cool, extinguished as I am.
